purpose: Resolve only GitHub-prepared stage-15 true SteamDB history misses through the scheduled ChatGPT runtime web path because direct GitHub Actions requests to SteamDB are systematically blocked with HTTP 403, while keeping all scope, queue, retry, completeness, validation and canonical persistence logic in GitHub.

github_control_plane.rule: GitHub decides exactly which SteamDB entity keys require evidence and whether the production stage is complete.

owns: fetch exact public SteamDB evidence for the GitHub-prepared keys
return evidence-backed structured outcomes through the prepared runtime artifact interface
scheduled_chatgpt_data_plane.rule: ChatGPT is an external fact-fetch worker for exact GitHub-prepared keys, not the SteamDB control plane.

interactive_chat.rule: An interactive user chat must not manually walk a large SteamDB manifest as a substitute for repairing the scheduled GitHub↔ChatGPT production interface.

execution_scope.rule: The GitHub-prepared current scope must be resolved as one production stage. Runtime batching may be used only as an implementation detail; it cannot redefine scope, quota, retry state or completion.

transport.reason: A controlled test on 2026-08-28 attempted all 51 stage-15 misses from GitHub Actions and SteamDB returned HTTP 403 for all 51, while the runtime web path could read the SteamDB price-history pages and exact Kazakhstan rows.

runtime_result_rules.app_page_temporarily_unreadable: May use exact SteamDB purchase-package relationship only when the app identity, exact active package relationship and a KZT lowest price for the same purchase content are all independently proven from SteamDB; otherwise blocked_or_failure.
runtime_result_rules.403_429_timeout_network_or_5xx: blocked_or_failure; never persist as negative cache

pass_requires: every stage-15 true miss has exactly one prepared runtime resolution
confirmed minima are exact KZT values read from SteamDB evidence, never currency-converted estimates
previously-free and unavailable-exact-history are distinct statuses
all special relationship-derived values have explicit SteamDB relationship evidence
